items.source: Allow subclasses to create the DataBinder.ValueResolver instance to use.
items.translation: 允许子类创建要使用的 `DataBinder.ValueResolver` 实例。

items.source: Create a new instance, with default object name.
items.translation: 创建新实例，使用默认对象名称。

items.source: Merge URI variables into the property values to use for data binding.
items.translation: 将 URI 变量合并到用于数据绑定的属性值中。

items.source: target - the target object to bind onto (or null if the binder is just used to convert a plain parameter value)
items.translation: target - 要绑定的目标对象（或者如果绑定器仅用于转换普通参数值，则为 null）

items.source: WARNING: Data binding can lead to security issues by exposing parts of the object graph that are not meant to be accessed or modified by external clients. Therefore, the design and use of data binding should be considered carefully with regard to security. For more details, please refer to the dedicated sections on data binding for Spring Web MVC and Spring WebFlux in the reference manual.
items.translation: 警告： 数据绑定可能导致安全问题，因为它会暴露外部客户端不应访问或修改的对象图部分。因此，在设计和使用数据绑定时，应仔细考虑其安全性。有关详细信息，请参阅参考手册中关于 Spring Web MVC 和 Spring WebFlux 的数据绑定专用章节： Spring Web MVC 和 Spring WebFlux。

items.source:
Note that this method resets any previous predicates that may have been
set, including headers excluded by default such as the RFC 9218 defined
"Priority" header.
items.translation: 注意，此方法会重置任何之前设置的谓词，包括默认排除的标头（例如由 RFC 9218 定义的"Priority"标头）。

items.source: Add a Predicate that filters the header names to use for data binding. Multiple predicates are combined with AND.
items.translation: 添加一个用于筛选数据绑定所用表头名称的 Predicate。多个 Predicate 通过 `AND` 组合。

items.source: Add a Predicate that filters the header names to use for data binding.
items.translation: 添加一个用于筛选数据绑定所用表头名称的 Predicate。

items.source: Set the Predicate that filters the header names to use for data binding.
items.translation: 设置用于数据绑定的标题名称的谓词。

items.source: objectName - the name of the target object
mpvs - the property values that will be used for data binding
items.translation: mpvs - 将用于数据绑定的属性值
